budgets.emptyBody: Set a limit so Piggy can warn you.

weekly: Counted per week, Monday to Sunday. The first and last week are trimmed to your payday cycle.
Rollover (Pro): what you did not spend last week is added to this week. If you overspent last week, this week gets less. Rollover starts from zero again each new payday cycle.
monthly: Applies to one payday cycle: from payday to the day before the next payday, not the calendar month.
No payday rule yet? The cycle uses the calendar month (1st to month end).
match: Pick a category: every expense in that category counts.
No category: expenses whose description contains any keyword count. Separate keywords with commas, e.g. "fuel, petrol".
No category and no keywords: all expenses count.
Piggy warns you at 80% used and once you go over, on the dashboard and on WhatsApp.
"Tell me what is left on WhatsApp" on: every transaction in this budget gets a reply with what is left. Off: just a ✅.
payday: Payday sets the cycle: monthly limits and savings run from payday to payday.
Salary arrived early (up to 10 days before)? The cycle starts on the day it arrived. Piggy spots it by the income category you pick or keywords in the description, e.g. "salary, gaji".
Paydays on the 29th to 31st move to the last day of shorter months.
More than one salary? Mark one as primary. The primary one sets the cycle.
